Data.subject: Consumer Price Index
Data.topic: Average Retail Prices of Selected Consumer Items
Data.title: Average Retail Prices Of Selected Consumer Items, Monthly
Data.footnote: Prices of items starting from January 2024 are based on the 2024-based CPI basket.  While they are indicative of the average transaction price levels in the same base period, they are not a measure of pure price movements across CPI baskets due to changes in the sample of brands/ varieties and outlets priced.
